outcome: Reduction in size of adipose and muscle tissues
Diameter difference of 5 cm in the leg
cohort: A 3-month old infant with an extensive congenital melanocytic nevus in the left leg.
finding: Extensive congenital melanocytic nevi in the leg are associated with remarkable reduction in size of adipose and muscle tissues in the same district, resulting in a 5 cm diameter difference without bone involvement.
